changelog.0.7.0: Read receipts: reading the clipboard (analyze/text/lens) now fires a popup with a distinct magnifier icon, the reader agent and a short preview (never full content) — so you know ClipLens is done and the clipboard is free for the next copy. Slack pen auto-converts Slack mrkdwn links <url|label> to standard markdown.
changelog.0.6.0: Consistent clip sound (default ON): every clip write plays the same sound across all paths (MCP + CLI + pens), configurable via cliplens_config clipSound (success|error|celebrate|off) or CLIPLENS_CLIP_SOUND. build.rs bundles the sounds next to the daemon binary so named sounds always resolve.
changelog.0.5.0: cliplens_ping handshake — verify connection + running version without touching the clipboard (no more throwaway test clips). Sharpened plaintext-default rule: naming a destination (e.g. 'for Slack') is not naming a format; Slack/Teams are opt-in only.
changelog.0.4.1: Fix slack/teams temp-file double-unlink (ENOENT) via finally. SKILL documents Figma clipboard structure (figmeta JSON + Kiwi data-buffer): text is readable, styles need Kiwi decode; no Figma pen.
changelog.0.4.0: Local config hub (cliplens_config): configurable image folder (OS temp default, never repo), ask-for-folder toggle, cache reminder toggle. Clip images no longer saved in the repo. Teams lens + link extraction + UTF-8 fix. Keyboard clip picker (arrows, sender+icons, no flash).
changelog.0.3.0: Runtime clip-cache toggle: cliplens_cache on|off|status. Local-only state (~/.cliplens/state.json), never committed, repo default OFF. Kiro skill install fixed to folder/SKILL.md.
changelog.0.2.0: Universal installer for all MCP clients + self-update version check. SKILL default = plaintext (vanilla), formatting opt-in.
changelog.0.1.0: Initial: Slack/Teams/Mural/Outlook lenses+pens, notify daemon, clip history.
